scope: Selected original native CTest invocations, not a complete Blender test denominator

count_definitions.ctest_invocations_exit_zero: Process exits only; the empty runtime invocation contributes no case passes.
count_definitions.executed: Original XML status=run, including a case that enters the test body and calls GTEST_SKIP.
count_definitions.passed: Original XML completed outcome without failure, error, or skip.
count_definitions.registered_disabled: GTest disabled names in the actual registered runtime listing.
count_definitions.not_run: Original XML notrun or suppressed observations, distinct from inventory-only discovery records.

remaining_obligations: Build and enumerate remaining configured original test binaries and Python drivers.
Reconcile source registrations and optional build/platform/backend configurations.
Resolve runtime fixture dependencies outside the hydrated candidate set.
Execute matched browser artifacts using the same original source-qualified identities.
Keep the original non-Apple shader_tool.MatrixConstructors skip separate from a passing assertion.
